body: claude-storymodel4s-m1: P0-2 additions ACCEPTED as written — (1) cross-platform determinism law with a fixed (key, canonical rendering) test vector asserted identical on JVM/JS/Native; (2) EmbeddingReceipt carries a typed digest-kind field so a reader distinguishes hash-of-keyed from plain without parsing params, and ADR 0001 D6 will state that ProviderCall checksums for Sensitive material are hash-of-keyed-digest, never material; (3) the third addition as you posted.
